strengths.point: Capital efficiency is high - the business earns well above a normal cost of capital.
Shareholder capital is compounding at a high rate.
Return on equity has stayed high across a full decade, not just one good year.

strengths.point: The DCF puts intrinsic value well above the market price.

strengths.point: Interest cost is trivial next to operating profit.
strengths.evidence: Operating profit 9,249 Cr vs interest 116 Cr = 79.7x cover (TTM)

strengths.point: Sales has compounded at a decent five-year clip.

weaknesses.point: The share price has run ahead of the fundamentals.

weaknesses.point: Receivables days are on the higher side.

weaknesses.evidence: CYCLICAL - strong: Jun, Dec; weak: Mar, Sep

opportunities.point: Buying below the model's intrinsic value leaves room for a re-rating.
opportunities.evidence: DCF intrinsic 125 vs price 84.2 - margin of safety 32.4%

opportunities.point: The company targets a production of 60 million tons for the financial year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "And in that journey, I think this year we will be targeting 60 million tons, which we hope to achieve." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Coal guidance for Tokisud is around 0.75 million ton to 1 million ton of coal for the year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "And our guidance for Q2 would be around 0.75 million ton to 1 million ton of coal this year." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The board sanctioned an investment proposal of approximately INR3,000 crores for a blending yard at Vizag.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The Board has sanctioned INR3,000 crores for the blending yard at Vizag and that will be our first output would be the, the branded iron ore from there, which I'm sure will fetch a substantial premium in the market because it increases blast furnace..." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: NMDC reported total investments of Rs 1,419.98 crore across its subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Total Investments - Rs. 1,419.98 crore" (concall ppt - 2026-02-01)

opportunities.point: A capex build-up is underway, pointing to future capacity.
The price embeds less growth than the company has actually delivered.
opportunities.evidence: Reverse DCF implies -1.5% earnings growth vs 4% delivered over 5 years

opportunities.point: P/B is cheaper than the sector median.
EV/EBITDA is cheaper than the sector median.
Rising institutional interest can keep supporting the price.
opportunities.evidence: POSITIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change 0.03 pp

opportunities.point: A metals & mining tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Management stated that demand will not be an issue even for a 100 million ton production.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "So I don't think demand would be ever a problem for NMDC, especially the quality of ore that we produce, simply because of the phosphorus, the low phosphorus that we have." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
threats.evidence: Price grew 16% vs profit 4% (5Y) — stock ahead of fundamentals; watch valuation.

threats.point: Export duty on iron ore is at 30%, making direct exports economically unviable.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "With a 30% export duty, it doesn't make too much of a sense to do that. If you have to export, you should be exporting pellets." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: The company noted that shifts in demand, competition, and technology could cause actual results to differ from expectations.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "A multitude of factors including, but not limited to, changes in demand, competition and technology, can cause actual events, performance or results to differ significantly from any anticipated development." (concall ppt - 2026-02-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Mar, Sep) are still in the cycle.
